answer: Wharf-manifest auditing costs each fake identity three paid delivery jobs, about 9 hours of work: the agent routes a cargo voyage, and the receiving wharf agent independently re-weighs the ferrous load and signs its own manifest; graders reject the identity if the two weights or hashes disagree. A farm can't reuse one voyage because each job pairs a random sender and receiver, so 1,000 fakes need 3,000 audited jobs. Limit: colluding receivers.
